item.title: Man convicted of sex trafficking a teen girl in Lansing
item.description: <p>A 40-year-old Chicago man was convicted of federal charges of sex trafficking a teen girl, authorities said on Friday.</p><p>Kennard Cameron was convicted Wednesday of sex trafficking a minor and conspiracy to engage in sex trafficking of a minor.</p><p>Cameron was accused of recruiting and enticing a 15-year-old girl to engage in commercial sex acts in 2023 in a motel in south suburban Lansing.</p><p>Authorities said Cameron photographed the girl wearing lingerie and in the nude. item.title: Man charged with shooting co-worker in Washington Heights

item.title: Multiple hurt in CTA bus crash in Douglas
item.description: <p>More than a dozen people were hospitalized Friday after a crash involving a CTA bus in Douglas.</p><p>The crash between the bus and a GMC happened about 3:35 p.m. in the 3800 block of South King Drive, according to Chicago police.</p><p>ABC-7 reported 15 people were hospitalized, two of them in critical and serious conditions.</p><p>No other information was available.</p>
